name: sonner
title: Sonner
responsibility: Toast notifications — success/error/confirmation feedback with promise-based lifecycles. The polish layer for user feedback.
reachFor: Temporary user feedback that must not block layout
avoid: Persistent in-layout status surfaces — use app-system status components
Actionable multi-step notifications — build a real surface, not a toast
reactWiring: <Toaster /> mounted once at the shell root; toast()/toast.promise() anywhere; richColors, position, theme tokens
